items.detail: The lower FcRn cup overlaps the schematic arm rather than clearly contacting Fc. The primary review locates the binding site at CH2/CH3. Clarify the native annotation with the source-figure owner; no atomic-geometry approval is granted.
The CDC target is clipped at the left source-canvas edge in both PNG themes. The complete canvas was viewed; this is not a tool crop.
Four Janeway chapters remain behind reCAPTCHA. Accessible review, textbook and primary passages support the adopted definitions; the blocked chapters remain unread.

No paper or whole guidance was read end to end. Twelve substantive abstracts, one boilerplate correction abstract, 84 complete targeted HTML blocks, three PDF text pages and selected UniProt annotations retain separate scopes.

Of 58 explicitly attributable public-file hash assertions, 40 match at least one pin and 18 match neither. A further 63 structured/private assertions are not attributed to owner-file bytes or followed as private paths. An unmatched hash is not evidence of fabrication.

Historical actor, no-model-call, browser, focus, owner and PASS strings remain claims. No new hosted-browser, hydration, mobile, keyboard, accessibility, human, expert, owner, learner or language acceptance is granted.
Four parent Mermaid blocks were read as source only; no fresh rendered Mermaid view is claimed. Twelve native figure variants were freshly viewed in full.
